title: Recursive step for the composed restriction parameter
statement:
Fix a fan-in bound $w$, a width parameter $l > 0$, and a depth $d \ge 3$, and for these values write $\delta(w,l,d)$ for the composed Bernoulli restriction parameter, namely $\delta(w,l,d) = \frac{1}{40w}\left(\frac{1}{40l}\right)^{d-2}$. Then decreasing the depth by one removes a single factor of $1/(40l)$:
\[
  \delta(w,l,d) = \delta(w,l,d-1)\cdot\frac{1}{40l}.
\]
replaced:
For $d\ge 3$ and $l>0$, the composed parameter factors as the $(d-1)$ case times $1/(40l)$:
\[
  \mathrm{composedDelta}(w,l,d) = \mathrm{composedDelta}(w,l,d-1)\cdot\frac{1}{40l}.
\]
